headline: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 redesign leaks ahead of July 22 launch
summary: Leaked images reveal a shorter, wider design for the upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8, alongside key specs like a Snapdragon 8 Elite For Galaxy chip and improved cameras.
details: Leaker Evan Blass has shared images and specs for Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Galaxy Z Flip 8, just days before the official July 22nd launch event.
The leaked images showcase a redesigned Galaxy Z Fold 8 that is notably shorter and wider than its predecessors. It's expected to feature a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite For Galaxy processor.

Camera specifications for the Z Fold 8 include a 50MP wide and 50MP ultra-wide rear cameras, with 10MP selfie cameras on both the internal and external displays. Samsung advertises up to 26 hours of video playback.

The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra appears to boast a 5,000mAh battery, offering up to 27 hours of video playback. Its camera system is rumored to be a 50MP ultra-wide, 200MP wide, and 10MP telephoto lens, with 10MP cameras on both screens.
For the Galaxy Z Flip 8, leaks suggest a 4,300mAh battery, a 10MP main screen camera, and a 50MP wide / 12MP ultrawide cover screen camera setup, mirroring the current Z Flip 7.
caption:
Samsung's next foldable, the Galaxy Z Fold 8, has been revealed in leaked images showing a significant redesign and impressive specs ahead of its July 22nd launch.

Leaker Evan Blass has shared images and specs for Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Galaxy Z Flip 8, just days before the official July 22nd launch event.

The leaked images showcase a redesigned Galaxy Z Fold 8 that is notably shorter and wider than its predecessors. It's expected to feature a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite For Galaxy processor.

Camera specifications for the Z Fold 8 include a 50MP wide and 50MP ultra-wide rear cameras, with 10MP selfie cameras on both the internal and external displays. Samsung advertises up to 26 hours of video playback.

The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra appears to boast a 5,000mAh battery, offering up to 27 hours of video playback. Its camera system is rumored to be a 50MP ultra-wide, 200MP wide, and 10MP telephoto lens, with 10MP cameras on both screens.

For the Galaxy Z Flip 8, leaks suggest a 4,300mAh battery, a 10MP main screen camera, and a 50MP wide / 12MP ultrawide cover screen camera setup, mirroring the current Z Flip 7.
